titleEn: Minimum Number of Removals to Make Mountain Array
title: 得到山形数组的最少删除次数
summary: 删除最少元素，使剩余数组长度至少三，先严格递增到峰顶再严格递减。
insight: 对每个位置分别计算以它结尾的严格递增长度和以它开始的严格递减长度。两边长度都大于一时可作峰顶，保留长度为二者之和减一。
pitfalls: 求最长可保留山形后用 n 减去它

solutions.title: 双向最长递增动态规划
solutions.idea: 枚举每个位置作为山峰并组合两侧长度。
steps: lis[i] 由 j<i 且 nums[j]<nums[i] 转移
decreasing[i] 从右向左由 j>i 且 nums[j]<nums[i] 转移
仅 lis、decreasing 都大于一时更新最长山形，返回 n-longest

code.java: class Solution { public int minimumMountainRemovals(int[] nums){int n=nums.length;int[] increasing=new int[n],decreasing=new int[n];Arrays.fill(increasing,1);Arrays.fill(decreasing,1);for(int i=0;i<n;i++)for(int j=0;j<i;j++)if(nums[j]<nums[i])increasing[i]=Math.max(increasing[i],increasing[j]+1);for(int i=n-1;i>=0;i--)for(int j=n-1;j>i;j--)if(nums[j]<nums[i])decreasing[i]=Math.max(decreasing[i],decreasing[j]+1);int longest=0;for(int i=1;i<n-1;i++)if(increasing[i]>1&&decreasing[i]>1)longest=Math.max(longest,increasing[i]+decreasing[i]-1);return n-longest;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minimumMountainRemovals(nums:IntArray):Int{val n=nums.size;val increasing=IntArray(n){1};val decreasing=IntArray(n){1};for(i in 0 until n)for(j in 0 until i)if(nums[j]<nums[i])increasing[i]=maxOf(increasing[i],increasing[j]+1);for(i in n-1 downTo 0)for(j in n-1 downTo i+1)if(nums[j]<nums[i])decreasing[i]=maxOf(decreasing[i],decreasing[j]+1);var longest=0;for(i in 1 until n-1)if(increasing[i]>1&&decreasing[i]>1)longest=maxOf(longest,increasing[i]+decreasing[i]-1);return n-longest} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int minimumMountainRemovals(vector<int>& nums){int n=nums.size();vector<int> increasing(n,1),decreasing(n,1);for(int i=0;i<n;++i)for(int j=0;j<i;++j)if(nums[j]<nums[i])increasing[i]=max(increasing[i],increasing[j]+1);for(int i=n-1;i>=0;--i)for(int j=n-1;j>i;--j)if(nums[j]<nums[i])decreasing[i]=max(decreasing[i],decreasing[j]+1);int longest=0;for(int i=1;i+1<n;++i)if(increasing[i]>1&&decreasing[i]>1)longest=max(longest,increasing[i]+decreasing[i]-1);return n-longest;} };
